name: Measure
subtitle: Seven, then eleven.
signs: Locks open only if you measure their time. Follow the steps at the top of the screen.
Start the lock, then stop it when its time is up. Within 1 second counts.
One glass after another adds up: 7 + 11 = 18.

locks.title: Lock: measure 7 seconds using the 7s glass

guide.text: Flip the 7s glass (press E beside it).
Step to the lock and press E to START it.
When the glass shows EMPTY!, press E on the lock to STOP it.

locks.title: Lock: measure 18 seconds = 7s glass, then 11s glass

guide.text: Press E on the lock to START it.
When the 7s glass shows EMPTY!, flip the 11s glass (on the right).
When the 11s glass shows EMPTY!, press E on the lock to STOP it.
